header.title: 4don Portfolio
header.subtitle: Minimal. Purple ambient. Maintainable. Projects loaded dynamically from JSON — plus a clean go-live setup.

bodyHtml:
Goal

The 4don Portfolio is my personal project platform to document automation and maker projects in a clean and structured way. The setup is intentionally kept minimalist and maintainable: clear navigation, a consistent dark-purple look, fast load times, and a dynamic projects overview (JSON → UI).

Features

Branding & Layout

  • ✅Apple-inspired dark mode + purple ambient look
  • ✅Multi-page structure (Home, Projects, About, Contact, Legal)
  • ✅Footer + copyright bar consistent across all pages

Projects System

  • ✅projects.json as the source (easy to maintain)
  • ✅Cards are rendered via projects.js
  • ✅Sorting (new → old), search, tag filter, badges
  • ✅Optional GitHub button + image fallback

Structure

This is how the website is intended (quick overview):

/
├─ index.html
├─ projects.html
├─ about.html
├─ contact.html
├─ projects.json
├─ robots.txt
├─ sitemap.xml
├─ 404.html
├─ site.webmanifest
├─ legal/
│  ├─ impressum.html
│  └─ datenschutz.html
└─ projects/
   ├─ rmv-morning-display.html
   ├─ pi-hole-setup.html
   └─ 4don-portfolio.html

Development (V1.x)

A short project log as a “presentable” timeline.

Step 1 — Branding & Purple Theme

  • Cleaned up template colors and made the purple accent consistent
  • Integrated a dark purple background (ambient look)

Step 2 — Clean footer & copyright

  • Kept the large footer (Contact/Links)
  • Kept legal links compact in the copyright bar

Step 3 — Load projects from JSON

  • projects.json as the data source
  • projects.js renders cards in the Massively layout

Step 4 — UX upgrade (Search / Filter / Badges)

  • Sorting: new → old
  • Search + tag dropdown + reset
  • Badges instead of “Tags: …” + optional GitHub button

Step 5 — Release preparation

  • robots.txt + sitemap.xml + 404.html + webmanifest
  • Unified head snippets (theme color, manifest, SEO)

Roadmap

V1.6 — Content upgrade

  • ⬜Detail pages per project (setup, screenshots, learnings)
  • ⬜Add demo links when available
  • ⬜Gradually make repos public + enable GitHub links

V1.7 — Design polish

  • ⬜Badges: finalize spacing/alignment
  • ⬜Cards: make “View details” even cleaner (icon/CTA)
  • ⬜OG images per page (Home/Projects/About)

Go-live checklist (short)

Before the final deploy, quickly check these:

Functionality

  • ✅projects.html loads data correctly
  • ✅Search + filter + sorting work
  • ✅Links & buttons are correct (same tab / external)

Release

  • ✅/robots.txt + /sitemap.xml are reachable
  • ✅/404.html in the 4don look + (optional) noindex
  • ✅/site.webmanifest is correct (name, icons, theme)
